image_description: Two fabric baby bibs lying flat on a white surface. The bib on the left features a grey textured body with colorful horizontal stripes (pink, orange, purple) and a red patterned flap. The bib on the right has a grey body with a faint white graphic print and a blue upper section featuring a cartoonish character design with red and black elements. Both have dark blue piping around the edges.
